name: comp-463

frames.best_why: Shows the full footer row: rows-per-page picker, the 1–25 of 100 range and all four arrow links.

tagline: A footer pairing a rows-per-page picker, a range count and four arrow links.
summary: A single footer row with a Rows per page dropdown, a 1–25 of 100 range in the middle, and first, back, next and last arrows at the right.
appearance: On black, a small Rows per page label sits beside an outlined 25 selector at the left, a dim 1–25 of 100 range runs in the middle, and four tiny chevron arrows close the right end. The open menu lists 10, 25, 50 and 100 with a tick.
behaviour: Opening the selector drops a short menu; choosing 50 updates the trigger to 50 while the range and arrows hold still. A tick stays on the current choice.
demo_content: Rows per page options 10, 25, 50 and 100, with the range 1–25 of 100.
search_phrases: rows per page selector in a table footer
pagination with items per page menu
how many results to show at once
first previous next last page controls
use_when: A table footer where people should choose page size and also jump to the ends.
avoid_when: When the row is narrow: label, select, range and four arrows stay on one line without wrapping.
customise: currentPage and totalPages drive the arrows; the rows-per-page options and the visible 1–25 of 100 text are hardcoded, so real totals need edits.
weight_why: One small select and four arrow links; nothing runs in the background.

a11y.note: The select is tied to its label and each arrow has a name; menu and hover transitions have no reduced-motion handling.

issues: The 1–25 of 100 range is hardcoded and does not follow the chosen rows per page.
polish_why: Three tidy zones with clear spacing, but a familiar table footer.
